name: Tsuyukusa Miyabi
source:
[i]"I must prove to myself why I'm here."[/i]

Tsuyukusa's father is a police officer, his mother is an instructor of Japanese fan dance. Tsuyukusa has served in the Public Security Agency. He has a clear head and is good at intelligence work, such as planning operations and safety plans. He was assigned to the Special Organization Ord at the same time as Suo. Tsuyukusa handles things strictly with rules and believes everything should come after the rules.

[From [url=https://velvet-react.com/en/chara003.php]Official Website[/url]]
